'''Sama Zo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss (species)|Voss]] commando living during the [[Galactic War]]. He used the [[Bounty Brokers Association]] to put a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on a local [[Exchange]] leader [[Eryn Talosa]] - an off-worlder solution for an off-worlder problem.<ref name="BC1" /><ref name="BC2" /><ref name="WK" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sama Zo first appeared in game update 2.3 of the MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2013]].

He is only accessible through the Bounty Contract Week event quest series of the players in the game on Voss.
